verdict.line: You win by kiting at range and punishing his cooldowns; you lose the moment his E (Apprehend) connects and Hemorrhage stacks snowball into an R.

brief.thesis: Jayce's Cannon-stance Q (Shock Blast) outranges every tool Darius has except his E (Apprehend), so the entire lane is about whether he can close 535 range to hook you into his Q (Decimate) and passive Hemorrhage stacking. The 51.2% win rate over 2,606 games and Jayce's lane- and solo-kill advantage both reflect that structural range edge, but a single landed hook can flip a trade into a kill via his R (Noxian Guillotine) true damage.

theirWindow.when: His E (Apprehend) is up and you're inside 535 range
theirWindow.what: Back out past 535 range or hold near minions he'd rather not pull through. If he hooks you, he immediately follows with Q (Decimate) for sustain and Hemorrhage stacks, so expect the all-in the instant the hook lands.

yourWindow.when: His E (Apprehend) is down (26s base cooldown early)
yourWindow.what: Walk up and poke freely with Cannon-stance Q (Shock Blast) or auto-attack; he has no way to force range without it. This is your highest-value harass window pre-6.

start.why: 95.5% pick rate and 51.5% win over 3,066 games — the extra AD and sustain let you trade autos while kiting instead of relying purely on cooldowns.

boots.why: 53.2% win over 1,108 games. Cutting Q/E/R cooldowns means more frequent Cannon-stance pokes and faster access to R (Mercury Cannon/Hammer) swaps to dodge his E (Apprehend) windup.

core.why: Builds toward Muramana so your Cannon-stance pokes start hitting for real damage instead of chip.
Active haste lets you close distance for a burst trade or disengage the instant his E lands on you.

he keeps landing E (Apprehend) on you and you need a spell shield to block the hook outright

runes.keystoneWhy: 51.7% win rate, 32.6% pick. The movement speed burst after landing ability damage lets you open distance right after poking, which matters against a champion whose only gap-closer is a 535-range hook on a 26-16s cooldown.

summoners.why: 68.2% pick rate at 52% win. Ignite punishes his all-in windows for solo kills given your range edge; Flash is your answer to both his E (Apprehend) hook and his R (Noxian Guillotine) leap. Flash+Teleport (27.8% pick, 49.8% win) is the alternative if you're prioritizing scaling over early lane kills.

playing.title: Zone with Cannon Q
playing.detail: Stay in Cannon stance before level 6 and poke with Q (Shock Blast) from max range. There's no reason to let him walk up for free when he has no ranged answer.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown
playing.detail: His E (Apprehend) is on a 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s cooldown by rank. When it's down, harass aggressively; when it's up, hold position outside 535 range.

playing.title: Don't feed his Q sustain
playing.detail: Q (Decimate) heals him off champions hit by the blade. Never stand in melee range while he's winding it up, even to trade an auto.

playing.title: Pre-swap to Hammer before fights
playing.detail: Use R (Mercury Hammer) before he commits so you have E (Thundering Blow) for the knockback to peel him off after a hook, plus the stance's armor/MR bonus.

playing.title: Shove with the Acceleration Gate
playing.detail: Drop E (Acceleration Gate) and fire Q (Shock Blast) through it for the boosted range/speed/damage, pushing him off CS without entering his range.

playing.title: Respect the 5-stack enrage
playing.detail: At 5 Hemorrhage stacks he gains a massive AD spike. Disengage before his next auto lands rather than trading through it.

playing.title: Hold Flash for his R leap
playing.detail: R (Noxian Guillotine) lets him leap to you for true damage. Save Flash specifically for that leap rather than burning it just to poke.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own read of the matchup.
